audit.why: full phases[N].side and content win[N] agree row for row and match the packet: Dr. Mundo 1-3, Skill at 4-5 and 6, Master Yi at first item and 2+ items.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet records zero cooldown-sequencing cues in this matchup, and the content layer confirms it — not one number anywhere.
audit.why: The whole lane is timing: Infected Cleaver is 4s so his poke is near-permanent, Heart Zapper 17s at rank 1, Maximum Dosage a flat 120s against Highlander's 85s. That 35-second gap is the all-in window and it was never stated.
audit.corrected: spikes[0..2], mid, late and whys[1] now carry the Q, W, R and Highlander numbers and the concrete 'step up in the beat after his Cleaver' cue.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer says your true damage 'ignores his stacked HP'. True damage ignores armour and magic resist; it does nothing about a health bar. Heart Zapper (W) is also never mentioned anywhere despite being a stored-damage heal, and Grievous Wounds is never named in the content layer at all.
audit.why: The page tells the player their damage type solves a health-stacking champion, so they skip the one item that actually decides the matchup. The full layer already calls anti-heal mandatory; the content layer contradicts it by omission.
audit.corrected: Wuju Style's true damage bypasses resistances, not health. Heart Zapper (W, 17/16.5/16/15.5/15s) stores damage he takes and heals him off the burst; Maximum Dosage (R, 120s) heals a percent of missing health and then regenerates more over time. Grievous Wounds is the purchase that beats both.

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal is absent from every content field even though the full layer calls skipping it 'the cardinal sin'.
audit.why: Passive regen, Heart Zapper and Maximum Dosage are three separate heals; without Grievous Wounds no amount of on-hit DPS closes an extended fight.
audit.corrected: Named in spikes[2].text, mid, late and wants.you[2].

edits.after: Maximum Dosage (R, 120s) heals a chunk of his missing health back. Highlander is 85s, so you get two windows per one of his — all-in on the R cooldown with anti-heal already on him.

notes: Two things deliberately not written. First, the missing-interactions file claims Dr. Mundo can cancel your Meditate with Goes Where He Pleases (P); his passive RESISTS an immobilizing effect that hits him and drops a cannister — it applies no CC to you at all, so that claim is wrong and was dropped. Second, the packet flagged 'Maximum Dosage' as a suspect name twice; both are false positives, the name is correct as written. The real defect was the true-damage-beats-health claim, which appeared in two places and would have talked a player out of buying Grievous Wounds.
